claims.statement: Tom Allen judged Charley Mitchell the coming man after Mitchell's sparring exhibition with Billy Madden at the People's Theatre, St. Louis.
claims.excerpt: Tom Allen thought him the com- ing man, and Tom Kelly thinks his work very fine.

notes: The theatre name is garbled in the OCR ('Pir! eel theatre'); the People's Theatre is taken from the hint. Allen's presence at the exhibition is not stated outright; the opinion is in the paper's words, not direct speech.
